answer: Replica keys cannot share one ridge-flag window. Applicant locks 14.9 POA and draws permit RW-726 at hut C-4. Within 42 minutes they drive peg PG-8 into a cedar post CP-16, log wind 6.3 m/s for 70 s on meter AN-5 at cairn CN-9 below the south summit, then walk 280 m along path PH-3 so logger LG-2 records a 12-minute wander to booth B-6. Two non-kin rangers replay the track and match the peg serial. A reused permit, a gap under 8 minutes, or a missed booth keeps 5.8 POA and parks the key six epochs; 9.1 POA returns only after a later permit whose peg and path both change.
